notes.title: The game has become free
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508123/8655bfe742e8482763c28034ba1430e29f04212e.jpg[/img]

Now the game is no longer in early access, and will be completely free. Project support has been suspended due to technical problems. I'm sorry.
If in the future there is an opportunity to complete this game, I will definitely do it. It will remain free. To everyone who managed to buy this game, I want to once again apologize to you for the inconvenience caused.
